create_renderer: create a RendererPython instance with specified width, height, mode, and shading for 3D object rendering
add_object_to_renderer: add a 3D object model from a PLY file path to the renderer with optional surface color
render_object_rgb_depth: render an object with given rotation, translation, and camera intrinsics to produce RGB and depth images
remove_object_from_renderer: remove a previously added object model from the renderer by its object ID
calc_calib_proj_matrix: convert a Hartley-Zisserman camera intrinsic matrix to an OpenGL projection matrix with near and far clipping planes
